environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on a Kubernetes cluster behind an AWS NLB (Network Load Balancer) operating in TCP passthrough mode. The NLB forwards raw TCP connections directly to the pod on port 8080 without any L7 inspection. No ingress controller is deployed; the NLB target group points directly to pod IPs. The application handles HTTP parsing itself via Go's net/http. No WAF, no mTLS, no client certificate requirements at any layer.
